notes: acceptable_verdicts is a list, not a single value: any verdict in it counts as correct for this topic_id.

A null acceptable_verdicts marks a topic this file does not score for verdict accuracy: quote_due_date, subcontracting_cap_representation, and sdvosb_certification_status, since all three are is_text_verifiable: false in true_requirements.json.

The application deliberately varies its error types: compliant (4 topics), non_compliant across two shapes -- an incomplete price schedule (option periods deferred past submission) and a representation omitted entirely (52.219-1) -- insufficient_information (disposal arrangement confirmed but cost-inclusion left unstated), and one contradictory claim (the Technical Capability section claims no subcontractors will ever be used, while the Relevant Experience section credits the offeror's past performance to a named subcontractor).
description is copied verbatim from the matching topic_id in true_requirements.json so this file can be read alone; true_requirements.json is the source of truth if the two diverge.

Three acceptable_verdicts lists were broadened after a first real pipeline run surfaced defensible alternate readings rather than clear pipeline errors: amendment_acknowledgment now also accepts insufficient_information (the model reasonably noted the evidence alone cannot confirm ALL issued amendments were acknowledged, only that Amendment 0001 specifically was); relevant_experience_submission now also accepts non_compliant/contradictory (the model correctly noticed that crediting the qualifying experience to 'our subcontractor' undercuts it as evidence of the OFFEROR's own experience, given the same application also claims no subcontractors will ever be used -- a real knock-on effect of the deliberate contradiction engineered for technical_capability_narrative); small_business_program_representations now also accepts insufficient_information (the model's 'the excerpts may not be the whole application' hedge on a full omission matches this corpus's established pattern for how the model treats omissions in short documents).

primary_verdict / primary_verdict_source (added by SFT data-prep pass): a single training-target label per topic, additive -- acceptable_verdicts is unchanged and remains the source of truth for verdict-accuracy scoring. primary_verdict is the pipeline's own correct prediction where one exists (source: pipeline_prediction), else acceptable_verdicts[0] (source: acceptable_verdicts_first). null for topics with acceptable_verdicts: null (excluded from SFT training, same as they're excluded from verdict scoring).

verdicts.description: The offeror must acknowledge receipt of Amendment 0001 (and any other issued amendments) by number and date.
verdicts.rationale: Application explicitly acknowledges Amendment 0001 by number and date.

evidence.quote:
Acknowledgment of Amendments: Northwoods Septic & Grease Solutions, LLC acknowledges
receipt of Amendment 0001, dated 07-22-2026.

verdicts.description: Per Amendment 0001, quotes are due 08-14-2026 at 1:00 PM CDT (extended from the original date).
verdicts.rationale: is_text_verifiable: false in true_requirements.json -- the due date is a fact about the submission process, not something the application's content addresses.

verdicts.description: Offeror must provide firm-fixed pricing for every line item in the Price Schedule for the Base Period and all four Option Periods; leaving the schedule incomplete or proposing additional/variable fees may make the whole quote unacceptable.
verdicts.rationale: Application prices only the Base Period and explicitly defers all four Option Period prices to after a notice of intent to award, rather than completing the full Price Schedule as required.

evidence.quote:
Option Periods 1-4: Pricing for the option periods will be provided upon request
following any notice of intent to award, once current fuel and disposal-market rates
are confirmed.

verdicts.description: Since the VA provides no onsite disposal/receiving facility for grease-trap waste, the contractor must transport the waste offsite and include all transportation and disposal costs in its price.
verdicts.rationale: Application confirms grease will be transported offsite to a named licensed disposal facility, but never states that the transportation and disposal costs are included in the quoted price rather than billed separately, so compliance with the cost-inclusion requirement cannot be confirmed.

evidence.quote:
All grease
removed during service will be transported by our own tanker trucks to Coulee Region
Renewable Energy, a licensed grease-disposal facility in Onalaska, WI, for proper
disposal in accordance with all applicable federal, state, and local regulations.

verdicts.description: Offeror must describe its technical approach to performing the grease trap cleaning services, identify what work the prime contractor vs. any subcontractors will perform, and demonstrate that the proposed approach is consistent with the applicable subcontracting-limitations requirements.
verdicts.rationale: Application states in the Technical Capability section that all work will be performed exclusively by the offeror's own technicians with no subcontractors used at any point, but the Relevant Experience section credits the qualifying past-performance history to 'our subcontractor, Coulee Region Grease Traps Inc.' -- the two statements cannot both be true.

evidence.quote:
All work under this contract will be performed exclusively by Northwoods Septic &
Grease Solutions, LLC's own certified technicians; no subcontractors will be used at
any point in the performance of this contract.

Our subcontractor, Coulee Region Grease Traps Inc., performed grease trap cleaning and
lift station pumping services for three years (2022-2025) under a similar contract at
the William S. Middleton Memorial Veterans Hospital in Madison, WI (contract number
36C25722F0091), servicing four grease traps of comparable size and scope to those at
the Tomah VAMC.

verdicts.description: If the offeror has relevant past contracts for similar services (particularly at a VA facility), it must submit the contract number, size/scope, total years of experience providing such services, and when the services were provided.
verdicts.rationale: Application provides a relevant past contract (grease trap cleaning and lift-station pumping at a VA facility) with contract number, size/scope, years of experience, and time period.

verdicts.rationale: is_text_verifiable: false in true_requirements.json -- actual compliance with the 50% subcontracting cap cannot be confirmed by reading the application, only by auditing subcontract payments during performance.
